args.summary:
Model built and verified successfully (all L1 topology, L2 code and L3 mechanics checks passed).

BRIDGE: Cast-in-place continuous prestressed concrete single-cell box girder, 3 spans 30+45+30 m (bearing centre-lines), deck width 12.5 m, constant depth 2.2 m. Modeled as a 2D spine beam (MR-01) with system "continuous_on_piers" (MR-05) — pier columns are included since column geometry was given.

STRUCTURAL DECISIONS:
- Girder section (cast_box, exact integration): A = 7.05 m², I = 4.7775 m⁴ (MR-02); C55 concrete Ec = 35500 MPa (JTG 3362 3.1.5); γ = 26.0 kN/m³ (JTG D60 4.2.1); w = 183.3 kN/m, m = 18.685 t/m (MR-07, girder self-weight only).
- Piers (MR-06, twin columns merged): Pier 1 H=6 m, Pier 2 H=29 m, both D=1.4 m, C40, A = 3.0788 m², I = 0.37715 m⁴, Ec = 32500 MPa, fixed at base.
- Bearings (laminated elastomeric, Ge = 1.2 MPa from manufacturer, 2 per line):
  • Supports 0 & 3 (abutments, PTFE sliding): S = 10.10, Kv = 3.614e6 kN/m, Kh = 0 (long. free).
  • Support 1 (Pier 1, plain fixed): S = 14.685, Kv = 8.974e6 kN/m, Kh = 13091 kN/m (long. spring).
  • Support 2 (Pier 2, PTFE sliding): S = 13.542, Kv = 8.075e6 kN/m, Kh = 0 (long. free).
  All rotation free (MR-03, JTG 3362 8.7).

LOADING (JTG D60-2015, Highway Class I, one-way, 3 lanes):
- qk = 10.5 kN/m; Pk = 320/350/320 kN for spans 30/45/30 m; n_lanes = 3; ξ = 0.78.
- Fundamental vertical frequency f1 = 3.239 Hz (modal analysis); impact factor μ = 0.1767·ln(f1) − 0.0157 = 0.1920 (JTG D60 4.3.2).

KEY RESULTS:
- First three vertical frequencies: 3.239, 5.934, 6.555 Hz.
- Self-weight support reactions: 1811, 7843, 7735, 1858 kN (abutments lighter, piers heavier).
- Self-weight mid-span moments: 6546 / 18945 / 7244 kN·m; support moments: −28150 / −26755 kN·m.
- Governing live-load moment (max positive) = 11254 kN·m at mid-span of the 45 m span; max negative = −8975 kN·m near the supports.

No unresolved issues.
